blocks.tamil_translation: said. Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- In the dictionary, Taqahhul is said of something green that has withered from drought. The meaning of the word “Taqahhul’ mentioned in the hadith is the dried-up state that comes from giving up show, adornment and luxury in one's life and adopting a hard and difficult life.
(Badhl-ul-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبَسَةَ ﵁ قَالَ فَأَيُّ اْلإِيمَإِن أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: الْهِجْرَةُ قَالَ: فَمَا الْهِجْرَةُ؟ قَالَ: تَهْجُرُالسُّوءَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Amr ibn Abasah (RA) narrates that a man asked the Prophet ﷺ, “Which is the best Iman?” He replied, “(Iman together with) Hijrah.” Again he asked, “What is Hijrah?” He replied, “That you give up evil deeds.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِاللهِ الثَّقَفِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ! قُلْ لِي فِي اْلإِسْلَامِ قَوْلاً لَاأَسْاَلُ عَنْهُ أَحَدًا بَعْدَكَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ: غَيْرَكَ قَالَ: قُلْ آمَنْتُ بِاللهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَقِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب جامع اوصاف الاسلام، رقم:١٥٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sufyan ibn Abdullah Thaqafi [RH] narrates: I requested the Prophet ﷺ, “O Rasulullah! Explain Islam to me in such detail that I will not need to ask anyone after you.” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “Say, ‘I believe in Allah,’ and then remain firm upon it!”
